# PujaPath Workspace Notes

- [x] Requirements confirmed: Next.js App Router, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Lucide React.
- [x] Project scaffolded in the workspace root.
- [x] PujaPath pages and reusable components implemented.
- [x] Dependencies installed.
- [x] TypeScript, lint and production build verified.
- [x] No additional extensions required.
- [x] README updated with routes and run commands.

## Conventions

- Keep puja and city content in `data/`.
- Keep public contact, WhatsApp, site URL and social placeholders in `lib/constants.ts`.
- Keep pages server-rendered by default; isolate browser interactions in client components.
- Use the production build as the final integration check: `npm run build`.
